{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.22

|arg=
|eff=

|gr1= Camera Control
|gr2= Turrets

|descr= Enables/disables turret gun stabilisation.

|s1= vehicle [[enableGunStabilization]] [mode, turretPath]

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]]

|p2= mode: [[Number]] - can be one of:
* -1 - clear override
* 0 - no stabilisation
* 1 - elevation stabilisation
* 2 - traverse stabilisation
* 3 - both

|p3= turretPath: [[Turret Path]]

|r1= [[Number]] - the previous mode, also returns -1 on error

|x1= <sqf>vehicle player enableGunStabilization [3, [0]];</sqf>

|seealso= [[enableDirectionStabilization]] [[directionStabilizationEnabled]] [[lockCameraTo]]
}}
